capabilities.name: Offline manuscript production preflight
capabilities.notes: Read-only bounded text checks for process residue, placeholders, repetition and selected explicit reference consistency. Line-localized advisory findings; no authorship detection, semantic source validation, network, model calls, manuscript writes or upstream authority.

capabilities.name: Deterministic project core and packaging
capabilities.entry_point: uriel start / uriel verify / uriel doctor
capabilities.notes: Offline-first project confinement, content-addressed records, receipts, and zero runtime dependencies.

capabilities.name: Data Readiness and Gate 0
capabilities.notes: Exact active-generation identity, deterministic v2 SortSpecs and readiness receipts, stale/tamper invalidation, strict Gate 0 interlock, and bounded no-authority AI projections.

capabilities.name: Opt-in Research Verbatim Ledger
capabilities.notes: Default-off exact user wording with explicit manual, assisted, or per-project consent; hashed user/project isolation; exact-text and aggregate integrity; advisory non-rewriting drift review; read-only all-baseline paper fidelity, declared evidence/literature coverage, and material-change confirmation; plus review, search, export, disable, and removal controls.

capabilities.name: Three Integrity Gates
capabilities.notes: Scope and claim language, direct evidence, and adversarial robustness with fail-closed repair guidance.

capabilities.name: Strict Blessing and independent verifier
capabilities.notes: Content-addressed attestation of recorded gate decisions and exact bound artifacts; not independent scientific validation.

capabilities.name: Research lifecycle, workbench, repair, and submission
capabilities.entry_point: uriel intake / uriel workbench / uriel burst / uriel submit
capabilities.notes: Question intake, bounded review packets, gap records, repair packets, decisions, and submission support.

capabilities.name: Research protocol driver and analysis-plan lock
capabilities.entry_point: uriel next / uriel plan lock / uriel plan status
capabilities.notes: Read-only seven-stage path from question to submission that names exactly one next action with its reason, command, completion condition, and human/agent owner, plus an optional create-only assistant prompt. Plan locks are content-addressed, ledger-ordered, and make drift, post-results revisions, and unsupported preregistration wording visible. No authority is granted and a lock is not a public preregistration.

capabilities.name: Paper Builder with bound datapoints, citation and quote checks, and manuscript lint
capabilities.entry_point: uriel paper init / check / build / verify-build / lint / dp-add / dp-refresh / uriel adversarial
capabilities.notes: Canonical Markdown manuscript directory in which result numbers are rendered only from datapoints re-extracted from hashed artifacts; citations resolve to a verified reference registry; quotations are checked verbatim against held source text; claim anchors tie sentences to the project record; reported test statistics, intervals, percentages, and GRIM means are recomputed; conclusions are checked against recorded rival explanations; recorded models are dimensionally checked and must declare whether they are descriptive fits, predictive, or mechanistic, with the validation and rival comparison each requires; an opt-in adversarial mode demands claim-specific rivals, completed attacks, counterevidence searches, earned confirmatory framing, and doubly verified models; assistant residue, filler, unsourced attribution, and overclaiming are linted. Build refuses on blockers and writes a number-trace supplement and digest-bound receipt. DOCX/PDF export is not implemented, and no check decides scientific truth.

capabilities.name: Assurance depth, evidence microscope, and decision card
capabilities.notes: Exploratory assurance chains, evidence-strength records, and decision artifacts; no dedicated CLI contract yet.

capabilities.name: Bounded advisory AI handoff and review import
capabilities.entry_point: uriel prompt / uriel assist / uriel review-import
capabilities.notes: Metadata-only nonpublic defaults, 128-KiB prompt/review ceilings, exact hash-bound import, and an explicitly acknowledged bounded external-process adapter. The adapter is not an OS sandbox and no AI output has gate, publication, or Blessing authority.

capabilities.name: Synthetic Forge Trial fixture and adjudicated scorer
capabilities.notes: Validates the sealed synthetic fixture and scores supplied adjudicated findings; it does not claim a detector was run.

capabilities.name: Evidence ingress and Data Desk
capabilities.entry_point: uriel data plan / import / inspect / diff / reconcile / verify-generation
capabilities.notes: Bounded local immutable intake, structural generations, preserve-all reconciliation, and deep verification, with a measured synthetic receipt and installed-wheel exercise. Data commands alone grant no scientific or Gate 0 authority; only the separate exact v2 readiness lane can pass the bound generation into Gate 0.

capabilities.name: Operational Forge Method closure engine
capabilities.entry_point: uriel forge init / transition / verify / continue / verify-continuation / export / verify-export
capabilities.notes: Local-only immutable run snapshots, frozen transitions, content-addressed lineage, bounded strict JSON, reference and dependency verification, seven-cell blocker proof, transparent 12-dimension ordinal Next Move ranking, immutable continuation packets, exact safe next prompts, metadata-only sanitized exports, explicit staleness, and zero upstream authority are implemented. Automatic broad milestone closure, GUI, and AI execution remain unimplemented.

capabilities.name: Scholarly acquisition firewall and local-mock quarantine
capabilities.notes: Disabled by default. Exercises fixed registry, structured-query, budget, policy-trace, raw-byte quarantine, receipt-last storage, and offline verification boundaries against one confined local fixture. It ships no live source adapter, DNS, socket, HTTP, browser, proxy, credential, parser, or network path and grants no readiness, Gate, publication, or Blessing authority.

capabilities.name: Built-in local-model adapter
capabilities.notes: External and local models can consume bounded prompts today; Uriel does not ship an inference provider.

capabilities.name: Desktop GUI and native installer
capabilities.notes: The supported product is currently CLI/Python-first.
